content_data.meeting_title: Q3 Strategic Review: North American Renewable Energy Portfolio Expansion
agenda_items: Assessment of hydrogen infrastructure investment opportunities across key industrial corridors
Partnership evaluation with regional utilities for grid modernization initiatives
Competitive positioning analysis against European energy majors entering North American markets
Regulatory landscape analysis for carbon capture and storage projects in Alberta and Texas
Review of offshore wind development pipeline in Atlantic Canada and Northeast US markets
key_decisions: Established joint venture framework with three Midwest utilities for distributed energy resource deployment over 18 months
Approved $450M capital commitment for Phase 1 development of offshore wind projects pending final environmental assessments
action_items: General Counsel to conduct comprehensive review of regulatory compliance requirements for offshore wind projects with findings due in 6 weeks
SVP Business Development to initiate formal partnership discussions with identified utility partners and report preliminary terms within 45 days
Chief Sustainability Officer to engage with regulatory affairs team on carbon pricing policy developments across jurisdictions by month-end
CFO to present revised capital allocation scenarios incorporating hydrogen investments at next executive committee meeting in 4 weeks
